item.title: The SDD Workflow: Five Phases from Requirements to Verified Code
item.description: Spec-driven development works when the specification is a workflow, not a document filed away after kickoff. The point is a sequence of reviewable artifacts — requirements, design, tasks, implementation, validation — each reducing ambiguity before anyone, human or agent, changes production code.
